items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: They was angry at Ella B. Moore because she continued to do this, you know. so they say they stopped going out dancing around

ctx.x: Yeah, Slim and Shorty, they eventually came back, you see, and they were very angry, you know, at Chinch and Ella B, well, not actually at Chinch, you know. They was angry at Ella B. Moore because she continued to do this, you know, so they say they stopped going out dancing around, say, 'We didn't do it anymore after you left, you know.
So we figure we're going to leave too, you see. Anyhow, I got back with Miss Lucille Achet, and she said that it was time like to go to New York City, see.
